Nadia, Gideon landed on 280 seats for Vantorre Group. I posted that as a reply to your message in #strategic-pod.

His first July 1 message said 300, but he corrected it about five minutes later. The 300 came from a staging tab that counted sandbox logins from the May rollout. 280 is the active production roster as of Jul 1, and Ruth confirmed it in the thread.

That's a July figure, so check it's still current before it goes on the roster sheet.
